“行吧！”

李青山想了想后，便将钱收了下来，不过还是从一扎钱内掏出来四块钱道：“这四块钱，你们哥俩一人两块钱，待会想买些什么就买些什么带回去！”

在这个时代，两块钱可是不少了。

“多谢山哥，那这个钱，我们就收下了。”大壮和二壮面露喜色，倒是没有再拒绝，将两块钱拿在手中道。

“咱们先去置办些锅碗瓢盆之类的带回去！”

李青山说完，便带着大壮和二壮二人，朝着供销社赶了过去。

供销社在55年的时候就出现了，现在已经出现两年，李青山所在的土乡也有一个点，百姓除了会到供销社来购买一些家庭用具之外，还会土乡的集市上购买一些日常用具。

每个月的初一和十五是大集！

每个月的初五，初十，二十，二十五，三十是小集市！

除了在供销社和集市上购买日常用具之外，还可以去废品收购站这些地方采购，不过东西就是二手的了。

供销社的东西更为紧俏，也最为全面，所以李青山打算直接去供销社去购物，自己也不是缺那点钱的，过两日又要上山了，所以这四十一块钱李青山一分钱都没打算留下来。

不过，现在的供销社要七点半才开门，现在才五点多。

李青山打算带着大壮和二壮先吃了早点，然后再去供销社门口等着，尽快将物资采购了，然后将户口分出去后回家。

然而。

还未等到李青山等人去供销社旁边的早餐店吃饭时，倒是碰到了熟人……倒也不是熟人，家人……！！

自己的老爹，还有大爷李大奎，李青书，李老屯！！

他们几个是来乡政府办理户口分户的，李青山还以为他们会八点钟左右到，没想到现在就到了。

自从昨天晚上李青山吃上肉后。

李老屯那可是一晚上都没有睡好，不断在床上翻着身子，想着院子里那喷香喷香的肉香味道，越想越气。

这几个不孝顺的龟孙子，有了好吃的，竟然不孝顺自己？

真是可恶。

现在回想起来，那炒鸡的味道可真香啊，要是吃到嘴巴里面的话，满口流油……！！

乖乖，不敢想啊！！

一大早。

李老屯就睡不着了，匆匆从床上爬起来，拉着老大老三和自己的大孙子，朝着土乡的乡政府赶了过来。

想要尽快将分户的事情给落实了。

尽快将老三这个不孝子赶出去，等到他们在外面活不下去的时候，再乖乖回来求自己。

到时候，自己再狠狠惩治他们。

李老屯还就不相信了，李青山一个人打猎，能够养活全家四口人，开什么玩笑。

而且，他们家还没有口粮田的。

打猎这东西，完全就是靠运气，今天运气来了多打一些，也许未来一两年，都不会有如此的好运气。

到时候，就等着饿死吧！

至于李青书，除了来帮忙过户之外，主要还是来报名一下农村业余高小班，也就是李老屯所说的知识分子，七月份和九月份是挂锄期，也就是农闲的时候，一些农民脱盲入学。

不过这个时候，大家都不太重视。

而且办理点是在土乡的中学内，大家赶来赶去的也麻烦，比如说从石溪村赶过来还是需要一个小时的时间，主要学习时间集中在下午农闲后，大概一天两节课，一节课四十五分钟。

等到明年，公社化后。

农村业余高小班，就会落在各个大队中，到时候去扫盲就方便多了，但是所有前去各个大队的教师，都是从之前那一批学生中产生的，或者是已经扫盲成功的村干部。

今年夏天，还有冬天！！

这两期，是最后的机会，只要抓住了，表现出色，在大队内可以直接担任负责扫盲的教师。

若是表现出色一些，继续向上走。

也不是没可能的。

李青山给王春晓找的也是这条路子，只要王春晓能够凭借自己的能力将身份地位提高上来，他爹也不会让他嫁给赵霸，毕竟他爹也不是傻子。

“青山，肉这么快都卖完了？”李三奎望着李青山身后的板车，开口问道。

“嗯，价格低，卖的就快！”

“现在乡政府还没开门，走了一路也饿了吧，不如先去吃点早饭？”李青山开口提议道。

“嗯，也行！！”李三奎点了点头。

旋即。

一行人便朝着早餐店的方向走了过去。

只不过这一路上，李青书和李大奎，李老屯看向李青山的眼神极度不爽，恨不得将李青山给生吞活剥了。

早餐店门口，人倒是不少。

门外支着桌子，一些来不及回家吃早饭的都会在这里解决，不过大部分人吃的都是窝头和咸菜，这是最便宜的配置。

稍贵贵一些的就是热豆腐加上粥！！

早餐店是一对夫妻开的。

这老板娘看起来不过二十七八岁的年纪，窈窕的身段，风韵犹存的气质，两鬓发丝垂在脸颊两侧，将脸蛋修饰的小巧狭长，颇有几分早点小潘金莲的味道。

"Okay!"

After Li Qingshan thought for a while, he collected the money, but still took out four yuan from a bunch of money and said: "These four yuan, you two brothers each have two yuan, you can buy whatever you want to buy later and take it back!"

In this day and age, two dollars is a lot.

"Thank you, Brother Shan. Then we will accept the money." Dazhuang and Erzhuang looked happy, but they did not refuse, holding the two yuan in their hands and said.

"Let's buy some pots and pans first and take them back!"

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, he led Dazhuang and Erzhuang and rushed towards the supply and marketing cooperative.

The supply and marketing cooperative appeared in 1955 and has been around for two years now. There is also a point in Tuxiang where Li Qingshan is located. In addition to buying some household appliances from the supply and marketing cooperative, people also buy some daily necessities at the market in Tuxiang.

There are big episodes on the first and fifteenth day of every month!

There are small markets on the fifth, tenth, twentieth, twenty-fifth and thirty of every month!

In addition to buying daily necessities at supply and marketing cooperatives and markets, you can also go to scrap collection stations to buy them, but the items are second-hand.

Things at the supply and marketing cooperative are more in demand and the most comprehensive, so Li Qingshan plans to go directly to the supply and marketing cooperative to go shopping. He is not short of money. He will go up the mountain again in two days, so Li Qingshan does not plan to keep any of the forty yuan.

However, the current supply and marketing cooperative does not open until 7:30, and it is only after 5 o'clock.

Li Qingshan planned to take Dazhuang and Erzhuang to have breakfast first, and then wait at the door of the supply and marketing cooperative, purchase the supplies as soon as possible, and then go home after dividing the household registration.

However.

Before Li Qingshan and others went to the breakfast shop next to the supply and marketing cooperative, they met an acquaintance... not an acquaintance, but a family member...!!

My own father, and uncles Li Dakui, Li Qingshu, and Li Laotun!!

They came to the township government to apply for household registration. Li Qingshan thought they would arrive around eight o'clock, but he didn't expect them to arrive now.

Ever since Li Qingshan ate meat last night.

Li Laotun didn't sleep well all night. He kept turning over in bed, thinking about the fragrant smell of meat in the yard, and getting more and more angry.

These unfilial turtle grandsons have delicious food, but they are not filial to themselves?

How abominable.

Looking back now, the fried chicken tastes so delicious. If you eat it in your mouth, your mouth will be full of oil...!!

Darling, don’t dare think about it!!

Early in the morning.

Li Laotun couldn't sleep anymore, so he hurriedly got up from the bed, grabbed his eldest son, his third son, and his eldest grandson, and rushed towards the township government in Tuxiang.

I want to implement the household division as soon as possible.

Drive out the unfilial son Lao San as soon as possible, and wait until they can no longer survive outside, and then come back to beg for themselves.

When the time comes, I will punish them severely.

Li Laotun still didn't believe it. Li Qingshan could feed his family of four by hunting alone. What a joke.

Moreover, their family does not have a ration farm.

Hunting depends entirely on luck. If you get lucky today and hunt more, you may not have such good luck in the next year or two.

When the time comes, just wait to starve to death!

As for Li Qingshu, in addition to helping with the transfer of ownership, he mainly came to register for the rural amateur high school class, which is what Li Laotun calls intellectuals. July and September are the hoeing periods, which is the slack time for farmers. Some farmers go to school without blindness.

But at this time, no one paid much attention to it.

Moreover, the processing point is in the middle school in Tuxiang, and it is troublesome for everyone to rush there. For example, it still takes an hour to get there from Shixi Village. The main study time is concentrated in the afternoon after the farm break. There are about two classes a day, each class lasts 45 minutes.

Wait until next year, after communeization.

Rural amateur high school classes will fall into each brigade, and it will be much more convenient to go to each brigade to eliminate illiteracy. However, all teachers who go to each brigade are from the previous batch of students, or are village cadres who have successfully literacy.

This summer, there is also winter!!

These two periods are the last opportunities. As long as you seize them and perform well, you can directly serve as the teacher responsible for literacy in the brigade.

If you perform better, keep moving up.

It's not impossible.

Li Qingshan also found this way for Wang Chunxiao. As long as Wang Chunxiao could improve his status with his own abilities, his father would not let him marry Zhao Ba. After all, his father was not a fool.

"Qingshan, the meat has been sold out so quickly?" Li Sankui looked at the cart behind Li Qingshan and asked.

"Well, if the price is low, it will sell quickly!"

"The township government hasn't opened its doors yet. You must be hungry after walking all the way. Why don't you go have some breakfast first?" Li Qingshan suggested.

"Yeah, that's okay!!" Li Sankui nodded.

Immediately.

The group of people walked towards the breakfast shop.

However, along the way, Li Qingshu, Li Dakui, and Li Laotun looked at Li Qingshan with extremely unhappy eyes, wishing to eat Li Qingshan alive.

There are quite a few people in front of the breakfast shop.

There is a table outside the door, and those who are too late to go home for breakfast will settle here, but most people eat steamed buns and pickles, which is the cheapest configuration.

The slightly more expensive option is hot tofu plus porridge!!

The breakfast shop is opened by a couple.

The landlady looked to be in her mid-twenties, with a slender figure and a charming temperament. The hair on her temples hung down on both sides of her face, making her face small and narrow, and she looked a bit like Pan Jinlian.
